Home.heroTitle: Flies born on the water's edge
Home.heroSubtitle: Every fly is tied by hand, thread by thread, by people who fish the very rivers they imitate.
Home.featuredSubtitle: A hand-picked selection of patterns proven on Québec rivers and lakes.
Home.storyTitle: A new fly shop, an old passion
Home.storyBody: La Moucherie was born from a simple wish: flies tied with the same care you put into reading the drift. We're an independent, just-launched Québec business, and every order is prepared by hand in our workshop.
Home.valuesHandmadeBody: No mass production — every fly is checked before it ships.
Home.valuesLocalBody: Patterns designed for our rivers, our lakes, and our seasons.
Home.valuesQualityBody: We choose durable materials for flies that hold up on the line.
Home.newsletterBody: New patterns, seasonal picks, and notes from the vise — straight to your inbox.

About.title: Our Story
About.p1: La Moucherie started on a riverbank, in front of a fly box that was empty too often. We wanted a source of flies tied with the same respect for the craft found in the best tyers we know.
About.p2: We're an independent, freshly-launched business based in Québec. Every fly that leaves our workshop is prepared by hand, in small batches, with real attention to durability and on-the-water performance.
About.p3: Our goal is simple: whether you're chasing trout on your home river or exploring new water, our flies should feel like they were made by people who love the river as much as you do.
About.quote: A well-tied fly always starts with good materials — and a lot of patience.

Shipping.title: Shipping & returns
Shipping.intro: We ship anywhere in Canada. Orders are tied by hand and go out within 2–5 business days.
Shipping.letterBody: Sent as Canada Post letter mail, with no tracking. The most sensible choice for a handful of flies.
Shipping.trackedBody: Canada Post parcel with tracking from our bench to your door, and a delivery confirmation.
Shipping.freeNote: Orders of {amount} or more ship free, tracked.
Shipping.returnsBody: If a fly isn't right, write to us within 30 days and we'll replace it or refund it. Flies that have been fished can't be returned — but tell us anyway if one came apart, because that's something we want to know about.
Shipping.trackedZoneNote: The parcel rate depends on where it's going; your exact cost appears at checkout once you pick your province.
